newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Leighton says yr op profit on target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Leighton says yr op profit on target.

text.p: Construction group Leighton Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that its operating profit and revenue for the year to June 30, 1997 was on target and the outlook remained very positive.
"The outlook for the group remains very positive," Leighton said in a statement accompanying its half year results.
"...the directors are confident that the group will continue along a path of steady growth established in recent years. Operating profit and revenue are on target for the full year," Leighton said.
Leighton, which is 49 percent owned by German construction group Hochtief Ag, earlier reported a net profit of A$32.04 million for the six months ended December 31, 1996.
It said it is anticipated that the Australian economy will move into a cyclical upswing in 1997 extending to the year 2000.
Leighton said recent forecasts for the total value of work to be done in the construction industry over the next few years had been revised upwards to accomodate this outlook.
It said investment in resource projects was expected for both infrastructure construction and mining activity.
In Asia, the group's operations had a good level of work throughout the region with Hong Kong and Indonesia remaining the major markets, it said.
It said the investment in establishing a presence in Malaysia, Vietnam and the Philippines should provide a broader base of work in the medium term.
At 10.45 a.m. (2345 GMT), Leighton shares were steady at A$5.85 on light volume.
